messages:
Ashley (sales): Quick heads-up — prospect (regional bank) wants HSM/BYO-KMS for POC but is worried about inference latency and egress billing. They asked for clear tradeoffs and a sample perf test.
Ben (platform): Short answer: BYO KMS means an extra auth+network hop on decrypt/envelope unwrap. Typical delta: 10–40ms depending on region and their KMS latency. We can mitigate with DEK caching + local envelope sidecar.
Claire (crypto): Also important: what compliance level? FIPS vs SOC2 vs dual-custody. If they require hardware-backed key ceremony or attestation, that affects onboarding time and SOW.
Devon (solutions): Proposal: offer two paths in POC — 1) Redwood-managed envelope keys (no per-request outbound) and 2) BYO-KMS with a sidecar proxy for DEK caching. We'll provide perf numbers for both.
Ashley (sales): They want a pricing comparison too — how to present per-token delta vs fixed BYO connector fee? They asked: "what's the expected per-req cost hit?"
Ben (platform): Suggestion: model two numbers: latency delta (ms) + estimated egress ops (per-100k requests). Example: BYO adds ~0.5–2 cents per 1k unwraps if their KMS charges ops. We should call this an estimate and tie to measured POC numbers.
Claire (crypto): Security note: if we cache DEKs, set TTL and max-entries. Recommend default: 5m TTL, LRU capped at N per model. Also include a short FAQ on key compromise and rotation: rotate envelope KEK monthly or per-customer policy; DEK rotation can be staggered to avoid cache churn.
Devon (solutions): I'll send a tiny perf harness they can run from their env to measure round-trip. curl example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Key-Proxy: BYO" \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d @payload.json
```
Ask them to run ~1k requests at their expected concurrency and report p50/p95 latencies.
Ashley (sales): Nice. Also they asked for network diagram showing sidecar and firewall rules for HSM proxy. Can someone sketch visual or list ports/egress endpoints we require?
Ben (platform): Minimal rules: allow outbound to customer's KMS IP(s) on port 443, mTLS optional. If using cloud HSM, list region endpoints. I'll draft a one-pager with ports + sample iptables.
Claire (crypto): Also request: do they want audit logs forwarded to their SIEM? We can export key usage events via syslog/S3 — include that as an optional add-on in the quote.
ops-bot: support ticket created: #SUP-2026 — owner: Devon (solutions) — SLA 72h for POC planner.
Ashley (sales): Action items: Devon to send perf harness + diagram by EOD, Ben to draft ports/ip list and cost estimate, Claire to prepare short compliance checklist and key-rotation guidance. I'll consolidate and send to customer.
Ben (platform): ack. I'll include a sample cost calc table (per-100k unwraps) and indicate uncertainty bounds.
Claire (crypto): ack, will include required artifacts for attestation and input for their security questionnaire.
Devon (solutions): ping me if they want an on-call window during the perf run — we can schedule a 1hr test window to debug.
Ashley (sales): Thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll update the prospect and schedule the POC kickoff once we have the docs.
